programme.title: Andromeda: Rejsens hjerte (del 2)
programme.desc: Den endelige kamp for at redde det nye systemers Commonwealth begynder.

programme.title: Andromeda: Under the Night
programme.desc: Efter at være strandet nær et sort hul bliver kaptajn Dylan Hunt opdaget af et bjærgningsskib og finder ud af, at han har været frosset i tiden i 300 år.

programme.title: Andromeda: En bekræftende flamme
programme.desc: Dylan beskytter Andromeda mod lejesoldater, mens Beka begynder at spekulere på, om de kæmper for den forkerte side.

programme.title: Andromeda: At miste det skæbnesvangre lyn
programme.desc: Dylan finder en rumstation fuld af børn, som tror, at han er der for at skabe fred ved at dræbe deres fjender.

programme.title: Andromeda: D Minus Zero
programme.desc: Andromeda-besætningen er stadig ved at lære at arbejde sammen, da de bliver angrebet af Restorers.

programme.title: Andromeda: Double Helix
programme.desc: Andromeda bliver involveret i en fejde mellem en Than-planet og en nietzscheansk koloni.

programme.title: Andromeda: En mørk engel, en lysende dæmon
programme.desc: En slipstream sender Andromeda tilbage i tiden til lige før Commonwealths fald. Besætningen må gribe ind for at bevare historien.
programme.sub-title: En mørk engel, en lysende dæmon

programme.title: Andromeda: Båndene der blinder
programme.desc: Besætningen besvarer et nødopkald og samler Beckas bror, som nu er Wayist, og hans ven op.

programme.title: Andromeda: Lethe-bankerne
programme.desc: Et sort hul giver Dylan mulighed for at kommunikere med sin tidligere forlovede 300 år tilbage i tiden.

programme.title: Andromeda: En rose i asken
programme.desc: Dylan er fængslet på en fængselsplanet og må arrangere en flugt, mens hans besætning forsøger at redde dem.

programme.title: Andromeda: Hele Neptuns store hav
programme.desc: Castalianere går om bord på Andromeda for at færdiggøre charteret for det nye Commonwealth. Da lederen bliver fundet død, er Tyr den hovedmistænkte.

programme.title: Andromeda: Perlerne, der var hans øjne
programme.desc: Beka finder ud af, at hendes fars tidligere forretningspartner handler med et stærkt vanedannende stof kaldet F lash

programme.title: Andromeda: Tårernes matematik
programme.desc: Andromeda opdager sit søsterskib, Pax Magellanic. Besætningen om bord på Pax er 300 år gammel... men er ikke blevet ældre en eneste dag.

programme.title: Andromeda: Musik fra en fjern tromme
programme.desc: Tyr nødlander Eureka Maru på en nietzscheansk planet og får hukommelsestab. Han skal huske, hvad han laver, før nietzscheanerne opdager ham og hans kasse med stjålne varer.

programme.title: Andromeda: Harper 2.0
programme.desc: Harper modtager viden fra en døende Perseid, men opdager først, at Perseid blev eftersøgt af en dusørjæger, som nu har rettet sin opmærksomhed mod Harper.

programme.title: Andromeda: Tvunget perspektiv
programme.desc: Dylan bliver arresteret for at have myrdet en diktator for 300 år siden.

programme.title: Andromeda: Summen af dens dele
programme.desc: Andromeda bliver bordet af en drone fra Consensus of Parts, et mytisk mekanisk samfund. Ibegyndelsen er dronen venlig, men den forsøger at tvinge skibet til at slutte sig til Consensus.

programme.title: Andromeda: Frygt og afsky i Mælkevejen
programme.desc: Gerentex er tilbage, og han kræver, at Trance og Harper hjælper ham med sin nye plan: at finde Tarn-Vedra.

programme.title: Andromeda: Djævelen tager det længste strå
programme.desc: Dylan og Rev Bem hjælper et fredeligt samfund med at stå op mod deres potentielle slavehandlere.

programme.title: Andromeda: Honningtilbuddet
programme.desc: Dylan forsøger at skabe fred mellem to forskellige nietzscheanske stoltheder ved at eskortere prinsessen fra det ene sted til hendes arrangerede ægteskab med prinsen fra det andet sted.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Filtered Out
programme.desc: In 2000, teenager Tara Munsey went missing after a work shift at a Virginia restaurant. Did she run away, or was she the victim of foul play?

programme.title: Forensic Files: Water Logged
programme.desc: In 1989, the dead bodies of Joan Rogers and her two teenage daughters were found floating in Tampa Bay.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Social Circle
programme.desc: In 2003, Tiffany Rowell and three of her friends were brutally murdered in affluent Clear Lake, Texas.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Low Maintenance
programme.desc: In 2008, college co-ed Jenna Verhaalen was found dead in her Bryan, Texas apartment. Petechial hemorrhages in her eyes indicated that she was strangled.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Fate Date
programme.desc: In 2004, Rebecca Barney and her soon-to-be ex-husband Fred were found shot to death in their Tulsa, Oklahoma, home, which had been set on fire.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Trail of a Killer
programme.desc: In 2003, Kathy Lorick was murdered on a Concord, California jogging trail while talking to her husband on her mobile phone.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Gone Ballistic
programme.desc: In 2008, the body of Colorado real estate developer Alan Helmick was found by his wife, Miriam, who then became the prime suspect.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Seeing Red
programme.desc: In 2005, the body of young mother Summer Baldwin was found in a suitcase in a Texas landfill.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Skeleton Key
programme.desc: In 2004, nursing student Tamika Huston went missing from her Spartanburg, South Carolina home. A tip led detectives to her car, where they found an unknown house key that could help solve the case.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Funeral Services
programme.desc: In 2002, funeral director Lonnie Turner, Sr. was found shot to death. His son Lonnie Jr. became the prime suspect, particularly after it was discovered that the murder was committed with his gun. However, he had an alibi for the time of the murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Expert Witness
programme.desc: In 1993, young mother Tammy Tatum was sexually assaulted and murdered in her Longmont, Colorado apartment. Police initially suspected her estranged husband, but did not have enough evidence to charge him and the case went cold.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Marked for Life
programme.desc: It would take 46 years, handwriting analysis and new fingerprint technology to solve the 1957 murders of two California police officers.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Plastic Puzzle
programme.desc: A man riding a bicycle was fatally injured in what police believed to be a hit-and-run accident. Tiny clues found at the scene created a picture of the vehicle which struck him and led police to its driver.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Up in Smoke
programme.desc: When an elderly couple died in a suspicious house fire, their son became the prime suspect. Investigators turned to forensic science to determine if the fire had been set deliberately, or if it was an unfortunate accident.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Soiled Plan
programme.desc: Police instituted an intense search when the mother of two young children went missing. Twenty years after her body was found, new technology recontextualized old evidence and pointed directly to the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Headquarters
programme.desc: When hunters reported finding a skull in a Texas canyon, police immediately began an investigation. With a forensic artist's reconstruction, police eventually learned the victim's identity. Now all they had to do was find her killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: One for the Road
programme.desc: A married couple decided to escape the cold of winter with a mini-vacation in Key West. The wife went missing and police searched every square inch of the island; they found nothing but a pair of sandals which might have belonged to her.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Army of Evidence
programme.desc: A mother of two young children was found dead in her bedroom. Her death was ruled a suicide — but when investigators learned she had almost died in a house fire three years earlier, they decided to take another look at the evidence.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shear Luck
programme.desc: In 1991, when the wife of a serviceman was brutally murdered in the Philippines, investigators had to reassemble a tiny computer disk that had been cut to pieces in order to find the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Tagging a Suspect
programme.desc: Bombings are difficult to solve because the perpetrator isn't usually at the scene and the evidence goes up in smoke. In this case, pieces of plastic the size of grains of sand hold the key to finding a murderer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Strong Impressions
programme.desc: The wife of an Air Force officer was found dead in her bed with a plastic laundry bag near her face. Further investigation proved that the scene had been staged. Her death wasn't an accident — it was cold-blooded murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Cereal Killer
programme.desc: When a fire destroyed most of a home and a young boy went missing, police organized the largest search in the history of their small town. First the boy's backpack was discovered five miles from home, then his body was found 50 miles away.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Crash Course
programme.desc: A highway patrolman was dispatched to what he thought would be a routine traffic accident — until he looked in the car. He had seen hundreds of accidents, but none with as much blood as this.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Leg Up On Crime
programme.desc: The decomposed body of a young woman was discovered in a Bakersfield irrigation canal. If there was trace evidence, it had been washed away.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Tight-Fitting Genes
programme.desc: A behavioral profile caused the Baton Rouge Police Department to search for the wrong man. The real perpetrator may have eluded arrest, had it not been for a molecular biologist who painted DNA picture of the suspect.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Deadly Valentine
programme.desc: An obstetrician returned home from the hospital and found his wife on the bathroom floor. She was covered with blood and not breathing. He tried unsuccessfully to revive her, staining his clothes with her blood in the process.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Picture This
programme.desc: A Modesto, California teenager goes missing. With no signs of struggle in her home, police suspect she has simply run away — until her naked, bruised body is discovered in a ditch 20 miles away.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Oily in the Morning
programme.desc: When police recovered the submerged car of a missing man, they expected to find his body — but it wasn't there. The investigation that followed would uncover an obsession turned deadly.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Gold Rush
programme.desc: Emergency dispatch received a call from a man who said his girlfriend shot and killed herself. The autopsy revealed that the gunshot wound was not self-inflicted, and the evidence on her body would give police a golden opportunity to catch her killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Four on the Floor
programme.desc: When a Native American woman is brutally killed in the desert of New Mexico, her killers leave a crime scene rich in forensic evidence: tire tracks, shoe impressions and even the murder weapons.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Writer's Block
programme.desc: A brilliant young architect falls ill and dies just before she is to testify in a criminal trial. The autopsy reveals she'd been poisoned with arsenic. Investigators must determine who had a motive for murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Clean Getaway
programme.desc: When a dry cleaner employee is raped and murdered in her store, police turn to forensic science for the answers they need.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Prints Among Thieves
programme.desc: The murder of an eccentric millionaire was not entirely unexpected; he flaunted his wealth and cared little for personal security. The evidence at the crime seemed to indicate robbery, but investigators wondered if there was something more.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Unholy Alliance
programme.desc: When a young woman disappeared, police feared she was the latest victim in a string of similar crimes. A pair of bloody gloves, unique tire tracks and ordinary pine needles provided investigators with some extraordinary clues.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Cop Out
programme.desc: When a college student is found dead, evidence suggests that he knew his killer. With just three hairs and some microscopic cells, police unravel a web of lies and find the motive for murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Summer Obsession
programme.desc: In an affluent suburb of Philadelphia, police were called to the scene of what appeared to be an accidental drowning. The investigation gradually focused on one suspect who had more than a million reasons to want the victim dead.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Elemental Clue
programme.desc: When two women from the same town were murdered in the same way, police feared a serial killer was on the loose. At first they thought the victims had nothing in common until they found tiny clues linking them to the same man.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Mission
programme.desc: When a family was murdered in Arkansas, it seemed like an isolated event. But soon the crime was revealed to be part of an ever-widening circle of violence that defined a new age of domestic terrorism.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Cop Killer
programme.desc: In 1995, our nation's capital was also our nation's murder capital. Even the police weren't safe. While Washington, DC, law enforcement targeted criminals, the criminals targeted law enforcement, even gunning down officers on patrol.

programme.title: The FBI Files: .22 Caliber Killer
programme.desc: In Buffalo, New York, a sniper targeted African-American men. He held a city hostage, and threatened to ignite a racial powder keg. And it looked like others might be following his bloody example.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Polly Klaas: Kidnapped
programme.desc: On October 1, 1993, a stranger abducted 12-year-old Polly Klaas during a slumber party in her home.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Above the Law
programme.desc: California Highway Patrolman George Gwaltney discovered the body of 23-year-old Robin Bishop near her car on a remote desert highway.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Human Prey
programme.desc: Thomas Dillon killed five outdoorsmen at random over a period of three years in rural southern Ohio. After a tip led the FBI to the murder weapon, ballistic testing made a match.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Death in Alaska
programme.desc: The day began like any other for Cheryl and Paul Chapman, until the silence of a peaceful Sunday morning was shattered with a phone call.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Paradise
programme.desc: It should have been Shangri-La, but when bad blood developed, piracy took over and the only law was the law of the jungle.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Crazy Don
programme.desc: To the FBI, he was believed to be the boss of New York's most powerful mafia organizationthe Genovese crime family. Was Gigante crazy or was his behavior a shrewd attempt to disguise his position as a ruthless mafia boss?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killing Spree
programme.desc: In 1984, in South Florida, a rapist and murderer was on the loose. The killer was a ruthless and terrifying predator, the newest member of an infamous group known as serial killers.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Melissa Brannen: Missing
programme.desc: In 1989, residents of a close-knit apartment community in Virginia gathered for a holiday celebration. For Tammy Brannen and five-year-old daughter Melissa, Christmas was always a special time. Then without warning, the little girl was gone.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Unabomber
programme.desc: For nearly two decades a mathematical genius with delusions of single-handedly destroying industrial society, planted or mailed powerful bombs to unsuspecting innocent victims.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Murdering Cowboy
programme.desc: The sun set on the Wild West long ago, but some people refused to notice. Claude Dallas was one of them. A wily trapper, Dallas typified the rugged individualism that forged this country. He went too far when he killed two game wardens in 1981.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The World Trade Center Bombing
programme.desc: Terrorist bombings are what happen in other countries. Not here in the United States. And yet, in 1993, it happened in New York City.

programme.title: The FBI Files: John Gotti: Convicted
programme.desc: John Gotti was ambitious, powerful and ruthless. He ruled with flash and conspicuous style, playing celebrity with the media and cat and mouse with the FBI. They called John Gotti the Teflon Don. Serious charges just wouldn't stick.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The True Story of Mississippi Burning
programme.desc: Philadelphia, Mississippi, 1964. A sleepy southern town steeped in tradition finds itself targeted for invasion.
programme.sub-title: The True Story of Mississippi Burning

programme.title: The FBI Files: A Model Killer
programme.desc: It's a model's job to rivet the public's attention. But in 1984, some aspiring models began attracting publicity in a terrible new way.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Deadly intentions
programme.desc: When abduction turns to murder, forensic science is the only key to finding justice for the victims of a kidnapper's deadly intentions.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Patterns Of Guilt
programme.desc: The tread of a tire, a single shoe print and even the shape of a bruise help investigators track down killers, based solely on their patterns of guilt.

programme.title: The New Detectives: A Deadly Smile
programme.desc: Investigators rely on forensic odontology to identify a body from a single tooth and to catch two brutal killers from their bite marks.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Military Justice
programme.desc: The Naval Criminal Investigative Service uses forensic science to solve three perplexing murders and fulfill their motto: "To the living we owe respect; to the dead, we owe the truth."

programme.title: The New Detectives: The Unforgotten
programme.desc: Years after a murder has been committed, investigators use advanced DNA analysis to shed new light on crimes that have gone unpunished for far too long.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Buried Secrets
programme.desc: Forensic scientists find clues written in blood as they investigate the deaths of three women killed by the men who once loved them.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Tainted Blood
programme.desc: The forces of nature can reduce a body to bones in a matter of weeks. Using a unique combination of art and science, forensic anthropologists give victims a face long after they have been forgotten.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Proof Of Innocence
programme.desc: DNA analysis overturns the convictions of three men who have spent years behind bars, paying for crimes they did not commit.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Drawing Conclusions
programme.desc: A teenager is abducted on a shopping trip. Two hikers disappear from the Appalachian Trail.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Stranger Than Fiction
programme.desc: A millionaire is found dead, murdered for a stash of buried silver. A young woman dates violent men, only to be killed by her best friend.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Predators and Parasites
programme.desc: For the forensic entomologist, the insects that nest in dead bodies are like tiny witnesses to a crime.

programme.title: The New Detectives: In the Camera's Eye
programme.desc: Photography has long been a vital tool in homicide investigations. A single image captures enough information to identify a suspect, and to preserve a vital clue long after a witness' memory fades.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Wasted Youth
programme.desc: When teenagers are driven to kill, their victims are but the first to fall. In three such cases, the families of the killers, as well as their communities, become the victims of violent crime.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Collective Justice
programme.desc: Philadelphia's Vidocq Society, named after an 18th Century French detective, is one of the world's most unusual crime-solving organizations.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Murder For Hire
programme.desc: For some killers, murder can be a profitable business. And the scene of the crime can be both a source for clues, and puzzling questions. When a victim has been targeted for death, investigators must look beyond the obvious to uncover a murder for hire.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Toxic Death
programme.desc: Sometimes, the cause of death does not match the scene of the crime. When an untraceable poison is used to commit murder, homicide detectives turn to forensic toxicologists to follow a killer's tracks and expose a toxic death.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Material Witness
programme.desc: Lies and deceit can often throw investigators off the trail of justice. But when hard evidence contradicts a killer's story, police must use the clues to piece together the truth.

programme.title: Gone Fishin
programme.desc: Exploring the rugged Paringa River mouth and jet boating the Hall in remote South Westland.

programme.title: Gone Fishin
programme.desc: A relaxing morning of whitebaiting with Sid—classic Kiwi tradition meets underwater spectacle.

programme.title: Gone Fishin
programme.desc: Fishing soft baits and exploring scenic fishing spots around the Cavalli Islands.

programme.title: Gone Fishin
programme.desc: A soft bait masterclass in the Bay of Islands, diving for scallops and a young fisher’s first spear catch.

programme.title: Carp Wars: Episode 19
programme.desc: Carp Wars is the ultimate head-to-head carp fishing competition, featuring five of the best and well-known carp fishing personalities in the UK.

programme.title: Carp Wars: Episode 20
programme.desc: Carp Warsis the ultimate head-to-head carp fishing competition, featuring five of the best and well-known carp fishing personalities in the UK.

programme.desc: Carp Warsis the ultimate head-to-head carp fishing competition, featuring five of the best and well-known carp fishing personalities in the UK.

programme.title: Carp Wars: Episode 22
programme.desc: Carp Warsis the ultimate head-to-head carp fishing competition, featuring five of the best and well-known carp fishing personalities in the UK.

programme.title: Carp Wars: Episode 23
programme.desc: Carp Warsis the ultimate head-to-head carp fishing competition, featuring five of the best and well-known carp fishing personalities in the UK.

programme.title: IFISH: Australian Salmon - Port Lincoln, SA
programme.desc: Local knowledge is always best, so when young Archie from Port Lincoln told me we were gonna smash some BIG Australian Salmon off the beach - I knew I was in for one hell of a day!

programme.title: IFISH: Spanish Mackerel - Namotu Island, Fiji
programme.desc: The apple doesn't fall far from the tree. Down rigging big live baits, deep dropping for monsters of the deep and popping for those massive surface strikes - what more could Jet and I ask for!

programme.title: IFISH: Black Bream - Bemm River, VIC
programme.desc: Traditionally bream fishing is a game of bait and wait... well not if Franks around! Local East Gippsland guru, Frank Milito, gives PW a lesson in using vibes for BIG Bemm River bream, that you really must see!

programme.title: IFISH: Sailfish - Darwin, NT
programme.desc: When Paul hears the word "Darwin", two things come to mind - Barra and Crocs! So when PW got invited to fish for sailfish, in 20m of water, he couldn't say no! Get out your note pad and pen, because you're about to learn how you can do it all yourself!

programme.title: IFISH: Barramundi, Horizontal Falls, WA
programme.desc: There is only one thing better than waking up in the remote pristine wilderness of the Kimberley - and that's fishing it! Join the Worsteling tribe as they navigate their way through dense mangrove systems in search of the mighty BARRAMUNDI!

programme.title: IFISH: Yellowtail Kingfish, Jervis Bay, NSW
programme.desc: "Catch the fresh bait, get the BIG fish!" Join the team for a step by step lesson in down rigging fresh baits for big angry Kings!

programme.title: Icelandic Tails: Episode 1
programme.desc: Robson Green, the actor and host of Extreme Fishing TV series is our guest. He has never fished for Icelandic salmon. We travel to the remote pools of Kjarrá by helicopter and fish pools that are untouched the whole summer.

programme.title: Icelandic Tails: Episode 2
programme.desc: Charles and Alex Jardine travel to the highlands of Iceland looking for monster arctic char. Charles Jardine is a respected artist who specializes in painting fish and fisherman. The river they fish is a gin clear river, home to some huge trout.

programme.title: Icelandic Tails: Episode 3
programme.desc: Tiggy Pettifer, a passionate angler, is visiting Iceland. She is a well known personality in the UK being a former employee of the royal family. Tiggy gos to lake Thingvallavatn and looks for the Ice age brown trout that the lake is famous for.

programme.title: Icelandic Tails: Episode 4
programme.desc: The 93 year old Lilla Rowcliffe is coming to Iceland for the 30th time. Fishing the same river. Big Laxá. She brings along her grandson and great grandson that is 11 years old. Lilla has had an astonishing live and shares a bit of that live with us.

programme.title: Icelandic Tails: Episode 5
programme.desc: Mother and daughter fish both river Vídidalsá and river Midfjardará. The mother Joanna Gibson is taken along with her daughter Marina Gibson who is a highly skilled fisherman and runs her own very successful fly fishing school in Europe.

programme.title: Icelandic Tails: Episode 6
programme.desc: Robson Green is back with a friend and a colleague. Actor James Murray joins him for an adventure in Iceland. Fishing Laxá in Asum, or just Asum the two give a great performance in this famous river. Competition is on.

programme.title: Pure Fly NZ: Lake Otamangakau
programme.desc: Andrew Harding and Matt Hince team up to visit a huge man-made lake - one of New Zealand's most famous trophy trout waters - in the country's North Island: Lake Otamangakau.

programme.title: Pure Fly NZ: Southland Smelters

programme.desc: Med Spencer ude af billedet, gør Heidi et sidste forsøg på at blive gode venner med Lauren igen. Da Audrina begynder at tilbringe mere tid med Heidi og Justin, overvejer Lauren, om de bør blive ved med at bo sammen.

programme.title: The Hills: A Date With The Past
programme.desc: Gammel kærlighed blusser op da Stephen Coletti dukker op i Laurens liv igen. Heidi prøver at sørge for, at Stephanie ikke kommer til Laurens housewarming.

programme.title: The Hills: No Place Like Home
programme.desc: Lauren har svært ved at vælge side, da problemerne mellem Lo og Audrina eskalerer. Og Heidi tager et job, der vil tage hende til Las Vegas.

programme.title: The Hills: The Next Move Is Yours
programme.desc: I sæsonens sidste afsnit føler Audrina sig lukket ude af Laurens venskab med Lo, og hun overvejer at flytte ud. Lauren gør et sidste forsøg på at blive god venner med Audrina, men måske er det for sent.

programme.title: The Hills: We'll Never Be Friends
programme.desc: Da sæson fire starter er situationen mellem Audrina og Lo anspændt. Lauren forsøger at gøre et godt indtryk på en ny fyr, og et besøg fra Heidis søster Holly truer Spencer og Heidis forhold.

programme.title: The Hills: Drama Follows Them
programme.desc: Stephanie bliver uvenner med sin bror og hans ven da Lauren møder Spencer på sin fødselsdag. Kelly Cutrone fyrer en fra People's Revolution og Whitney overtager stillingen. Laurens forhold til Doug udvikler sig lidt for hurtigt.

programme.title: The Hills: Better Off As Friends
programme.desc: Lauren indser at den kemi, hun havde med Doug på studiet ikke længere er der. Whitney er nervøs for at tage til New York, men en date med en model gør hende gladere. Til trods for forsoningsgestusen vil Spencer bryde helt med Stephanie.

programme.title: The Hills: Boys Make Girls Cry
programme.desc: En vild tur til Las Vegas går galt, da Audrina ignorerer Lauren. Brody nævner Stephanies fortid, og drengene ryger i brummen. Heidis søster Holly flytter ind, men det er intet Spencer hellere vil end at smide hende ud.

programme.title: The Hills: Something Has To Change
programme.desc: Lauren og Audrina kæmper for at redde deres venskab, men det kan allerede være for sent. Spencer har fået nok af Heidis søster Holly og tager sagen i egne hænder. Og Brody og Doug forlader fængslet med nye historier.

programme.title: The Hills: You Always Miss a Best Friend
programme.desc: Heidis søster Holly tager kontakt med Lauren, noget som tvinger både Lauren og Heidi til at revurdere hvad der er sket med dere venskab.. Audrina og Justins forhold bliver sat på prøve, da hun arbejder på en event for Epic Records.
programme.sub-title: You Always Miss a Best Friend

programme.title: The Hills: When Lauren's Away...
programme.desc: Da Lauren tager på ferie med familien, går alting galt i Los Angeles. Stephanie dater Doug bag Laurens rygg, og Audrina og Heidi bliver venner.

programme.title: The Hills: Don't Act Innocent
programme.desc: Sandheden om Stephanies forhold til Laurens eks Doug kommer frem, da de alle mødes til Dougs poolparty. Heidis mor kommer overraskende på besøg til LA og ryger ud i en konfrontation med Spencer.

programme.title: The Hills: If She Never Met Spencer...
programme.desc: Lauren får et brev fra Heidi, hvor hun beklager og indser, at der kun er én ting, som forhindrer dem i at blive venner igen. Audrina starter med at date en ny fyr for at gøre Justin jaloux, men hendes plan slår fejl.

programme.title: The Hills: Who To Choose?
programme.desc: Audrina møder sin gamle flamme Corey igen og jonglerer pludselig to fyre. Spencer tvinger Heidi til at smide sin søster Holly ud af lejligheden.

programme.title: The Hills: You'll Never Have This
programme.desc: Lauren og Audrina rejser til Cabo til Brody fødselsdag, men da Justin bliver jaloux på Audrinas nye forhold, udvikler festen sig til en slåskamp. Spencer ydmyger Stephanie da hun finder ud af, at hendes nye kæreste er ven med Brody.

programme.title: The Hills: I Want You To Be With Me
programme.desc: Lauren prøver at skabe fred mellem Brody og Stephanie. Audrina vil få tingene til at fungere med Corey, men Justin vil ikke give slip på hende. Stephanie tvivler på sin nye kæreste, da han bryder sit løfte om at konfrontere Brody.
programme.sub-title: I Want You To Be With Me

programme.title: The Hills: It's Her Move
programme.desc: Audrina får sit eget sted, og håber, at Justin vil flytte ind hos hende, men alle frygter, at hun flytter af den forkerte grund. Heidi inviterer Spencer til et arrangement med arbejdet og bliver taget i at have det lidt for sjovt.

programme.title: The Hills: Back To New York
programme.desc: Whitney tager til New York i forventning om at møde Alex igen, men en ny fyr ved navn Jay fanger hendes opmærksomhed. Heidi er ulykkelig efter fyringen, men da Spencer taler med Brent for at skaffe hende jobbet tilbage, forværrer han situationen.

programme.title: The Hills: One Last Chance
programme.desc: Lauren lader Heidis søster overnatte. Justin inviterer Audrina med på en romantisk weekend, og Heidis frustration med Spencer vokser, da hun må tigge for at få sit job tilbage.

programme.title: The Hills: You Did This
programme.desc: Audrina tror på et rygte, hun hører: at Lauren har kysset med Justin. I mellemtiden prøver Holly at få Heidi væk fra Spencer.

programme.title: The Hills: It's About Trust
programme.desc: Audrina forsøger at redde sit venskab med Lauren efter at have anklaget hende for at have kysset med Justin. Spencer og Stephanie besøger deres bedstemore, som er træt af, at de skændes.

programme.title: The Hills: Dream Boy, Dream Job
programme.desc: Whitney bliver tilbudt en chance for a score sit drømmejob NYC og håber at se Jay der. Lauren bliver nostalgisk, da hendes forældre sælger huset i Laguna Beach, og Stephanie går til Spencer for at få hjælp med Cameron.

programme.title: The Hills: Mr. & Mrs. Pratt
programme.desc: Spencer og Heidi ignorerer deres bekymrede familier og stikker af til Mexico for at blive gift. Whitney går efter drømmejobbet i New York City, og siger farvel til Lauren og sit liv i Los Angeles.

programme.title: The Hills: I Heidi Take Thee Spencer
programme.desc: Lauren og Heidi mødes og husker, hvorfor de plejede at være venner. Spencer og Heidi er lige blevet gift, da Heidis mor kommer til byen. Justin chokerer Audrina, da han tager hende med til Palm Springs til en overraskelse.

programme.title: The Hills: Don't Cry On Your Birthday
programme.desc: Da Heidi kommer uanmeldt til Laurens fødselsdagsfest, græder de to gamle venner over deres ødelagte venskab. Spencer kommer op at slås, da Cameron beskylder ham for at samle en bartender op.

programme.title: The Hills: Everything Happens for a Reason
programme.desc: Spencers flirtende opførsel får Heidi til at tage hjem til Colorado, hvor hun møder en gammel kæreste. Lauren skælder Stephanie ud for at have inviteret Heidi til festen. Spencer ender en lang stilhed med Brody.

programme.title: The Hills: I'm Done With You
programme.desc: Da Heidi overrasker Spencer på en natklub med bartenderen Stacie, forlanger hun, at de går i parterapi. Lauren risikerer sit rygte, da hun skaffer Stephanie en praktikplads hos People's Revolution.

programme.title: The Hills: Crazy In Love
programme.desc: Audrina prøver at komme sig over Justin ved at gå efter Brody. Heidi slæber en modvillig Spencer med til parterapi. Da Stephanie kvajer sig hos People's Revolution, truer Lauren med at fyre hende.

programme.title: The Hills: I Always Had A Little Crush
programme.desc: Audrina prøver at glemme Justin ved at score Brody, da pigerne tager med på drengenes surf-tur til Hawaii. Heidis uskyldige ekskæreste kommer på besøg, og hun håber, at hans værdier vil smitte af på Spencer.
programme.sub-title: I Always Had A Little Crush

programme.title: The Hills: Playmates Bring the Drama
programme.desc: Audrina bliver knust, da Brodys kæreste konfronterer hende om Hawaii og Brody ikke gør noget for at stoppe det. Heidi opsnapper en sms fra Stacie til Spencer og tager på natklub for at konfrontere hende.

programme.title: The Hills: Keep Your Enemies Closer
programme.desc: Justin konfronterer Audrina om at være sammen med Brody i Hawaii. Stephanie ødelægger en fotooptagelse på jobbet, så Lauren får skældud af Kelly. Bartenderen Stacie prøver at slutte fred med Heidi.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: You Can't Handle the Truth
programme.desc: Cory og Taylors forhold kommer i farezonen, da Corys følelser for Alicia kommer frem i lyset. En kommentar udløser et stort skænderi. En ny eks kommer og får en uventet nyhed.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Return of all the Exes
programme.desc: Huset går i chok, da de eliminerede ekser vender tilbage. Et spil kvit eller dobbelt er uskyldigt, indtil Angela og Derrick gør noget dumt. Huset omgrupperer sig efter det store skænderi.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Can You Ever Get Over Your Ex?
programme.desc: En tur til SOS truer med at splitte et genforenet par. Chases kærlighedstrekant går op i en spids. Singlerne må beslutte, om de vil forlade Hawaii med kærlighed eller solo.
programme.sub-title: Can You Ever Get Over Your Ex?

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Body SOS: Paige og Sam
programme.desc: Paige vil ikke fastsætte en bryllupsdato, før hun taber sig, og Sam vil få muskler for at slå igennem som model. Kan de forvandle sig i tide til at vise sig frem i Ex on the Beach?

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Body SOS: Jourdan og Liam
programme.desc: Jourdan vil tabe sig for at få sin Beyoncé-facon tilbage, og Bertram vil få muskler for at slå igennem som skuespiller. Kan de forvandle sig i tide til at vise sig frem i Ex on the Beach?

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Body SOS: Deano og Paris
programme.desc: Deano er desperat efter at slippe af med dellerne og se lige så muskuløs ud som sine venner, så han kan begynde at date. Paris vil få styr på sine former og få sin selvtillid tilbage. Opnår de en forvandling før deres store Ex on the Beach-afsløring?

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Body SOS: Becci og Kieran
programme.desc: Becci er træk af at være den tykke søster og vil tabe sig. Kieran er træt af at være en splejs og vil have muskler. Kan de forvandle deres kroppe i tide til deres Ex on the Beach-afsløring?

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Body SOS: Ronan og Camilla
programme.desc: Ronan har taget en masse kilo på og er nede over det, mens Camilla vil tabe sig før sin pigeferie. Når de at forandre deres liv i tide til deres Ex on the Beach-afsløring?

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Body SOS: Shelbie og Liv & Vanessa
programme.desc: Vennerne Shelbie & Liv har tager voldsomt på og trænger til at tabe sig. Vanessa drømmer om at få en krop som en kvindelig bryder. Kan de forvandle deres kroppe i tide til deres Ex on the Beach-afsløring?

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Body SOS: Mahan og Lydia
programme.desc: Pizzeria-ejeren Mahan har spist for meget dej og vil af med dellerne, mens Lydia vil have sin gamle krop tilbage. Kan de forvandle sig i tide til deres Ex on the Beach-afsløring?

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Body SOS: Sheena og Georgia
programme.desc: Sheena har brug for at tabe sig til sin bryllupsrejse, og Georgia vil tage sig for at blive, som hun var før. Kan de nå at ændre deres liv i tide til deres Ex on the Beach-afsløring?

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: Middagsdates med eks som tilbehør.
programme.desc: De single kendisser mødes til et poolparty og kaster sig ud i romantik. Men da terrortabletten siger, de skal have intime middagsdates, får de et chok over, at en eks ryger ud første aften.

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: Taget på sengen
programme.desc: Det er alt eller intet for Finn & Paige. Kendisserne fester på en strandklub, men Ashley kommer i tvivl om sit forhold til Jarred, og en stor kendis-ankomst tager Yaz på sengen.

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: Jeg er smuttet
programme.desc: Yaz, Chloe og Brockett får sig en snak. Finn og Paige har svært ved at bo sammen. En ny eks ryster et par ind til grunden.

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: Kærlighed med bump på vejen
programme.desc: Chloe, Veitch og Finn bliver tættere, og det er svært for Paige. Der er problemer i Yaz Chloe Brocketts venskab og en overraskende eks' ankomst truer med at ødelægge et par.

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: Løve-eksen
programme.desc: Chloe Veitch befinder i et trekantsdrama. Yaz Chloe Brockett venskab går fuldstændig galt, bådfesten bliver rystet af en eks på jetski, og tre kendisser bliver sendt på stranden, hvor den næste eks gemmer sig i mørket.

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: Aftenstranden
programme.desc: Kan Lockie og Yaz finde ud af at bo sammen? Chloe lægger alle sine æg i en kurv og en djævelsk flot kendis ryster villaen, men hvem ryger hjem nu?

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: Den eneste vej er eks

programme.title: Are You The One?: Getting Dumped On
programme.desc: Kayla og Ryan skændes, men huset vender sig mod Kayla, da hun afslører følsomme oplysninger, der truer Ambers forhold til Ethan. En slibrig udfordring tester nogle af parrenes evne til at holde sammen.

programme.title: Are You The One?: White Party
programme.desc: Til hvid fest har alle i huset det sjovt, men John må forholde sig til Jacys følelser for Scali. I en udfordring på stranden får parrene sand under neglene.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Rub Down With A Happy Ending
programme.desc: Huset forsøger at regne ud, hvordan de finder deres perfekte match og vinder en million dollars. Jacy ser sine følelser for Scali og John i øjnene, da huset forsøger at løse den sidste kærlighedstrekant.
programme.sub-title: Rub Down With A Happy Ending

programme.title: Are You The One?: Reunion Special
programme.desc: Alle de tyve deltagere bliver genforenet med Ryan Devlin for at diskutere, hvad der skete på Hawaii, og vi viser ikke tidligere vist materiale, chokerende afsløringer og sladder om parrene som fortsat er sammen.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Are You The One? Special Delivery
programme.desc: Deltagerne i første sæson genforenes til den største begivenhed i Ethans og Ambers liv - en baby! Find ud af, hvordan det er gået med deltagerne, mens de tilbringer en vild weekend sammen for at fejre babyen med et AYTO-gave.
programme.sub-title: Are You The One? Special Delivery

programme.title: Are You The One?: One Too Many
programme.desc: 10 perfekt sammensatte fyre og piger får et chok, når de finder ud af, det bliver sværere at finde 10 par, for der er 11 piger. Paris og Pratt prøver at undgå den første sandhedsbås.

programme.title: Are You The One?: The Truth Will Cost You
programme.desc: Teamet bliver spændt, da både Layton og Shelby havner i kærlighedstrekanter. Fyrene graver ting op om pigerne i en konkurrence, som kan sende den ellevte pige i sandhedsbåsen.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Virgin Tears
programme.desc: Der er tårer, da Shelby afslutter sin kærlighedstrekant. John prøver at nærme sig Christina, men bliver blokeret af Brandon, hendes ikke-match. Teamet bliver chokeret da de hører, at der er en jomfru blandt dem.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Loose Lips Sink Relationships
programme.desc: En fuld kikser kan splitte det stærkeste par i huset. Anthony bager heftigt på Laytons forelskelse, Jenni. John prøver endelig lykken med Christina. Parceremonien gør huset helt rundt på gulvet.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Strap Those Boots Tight
programme.desc: Huset er chokeret efter sidste parceremoni. Jenni mener, at Layton er hendes rette fyr, men frygter at en knust Jessica bliver vred. For et par truer sandhedsbåsen med at bringe mere hjertesorg.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Parental Guidance
programme.desc: Pigerne får overraskende informationer, når deres forældre kommer for at udspørge fyrene. Når forældrene rejser, eksploderer spændingerne mellem Layton og Anthony. Huset finder ud af, at historien kan gentage sig.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Hot Salsa
programme.desc: Efter en mislykket parceremoni er huset klar til en ny start. John mener endelig at have fundet den rette i Jenni, men de andre i huset er ikke så sikre. Ashley befinder sig i et potentielt eksplosivt trekantsdrama.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Dumped
programme.desc: Kampen mellem Dario og Layton over Ashley strammer til. Ellie vender sin opmærksomhed mod Nathan, som er overbevist om, at Christina er hans perfekte partner. For Christina bliver presset med at være pige nummer 11 for meget.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Old Flames
programme.desc: Selvom de ikke er et par, eksploderer Nathan, når Christina går tilbage til Brandon. Med to parceremonier tilbage, kunne Ashleys ubeslutsomhed mellem Layton og Dario afholde huset fra at vinde det hele.

programme.title: Are You The One?: One Switch, One Glitch
programme.desc: Det er den sidste parceremoni og de skal udskifte et par. Mens sandhedsbåsen giver et tiltrængt svar, bringer spørgsmålet om pige nummer 11 millionen i fare.

programme.title: Are You The One?: The Season Aftermatch
programme.desc: Hele sæsonens hemmeligheder, drama og uafklarede affærer kommer frem i lyset i dette genforeningsafsnit, hvor de medvirkende skiftes til at sidde i den varme stol.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Perfect Match at First Sight
programme.desc: 20 singler ankommer til Hawaii for at finde kærlighed og vinde 1 million dollar. Deres kærlighed ved første blik-instinkter bliver sat på prøve med 250.000 ekstra på spil. En kærlighedstrekant fører til en pinlig parceremoni.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Punch Drunk Love
programme.desc: John eksploderer, når forholdet til Julia forandrer sig. Asaf og Francesca ved ikke, hvor de står, da en tur til bolleværelset kikser. Kaylen slipper en bombe om sit forhold til Gio, som chokerer huset.

programme.title: Are You The One?: She Don't Want You
programme.desc: John flipper skråt, da Stephen bager på Julia. Tori og Camille er begge ude efter den samme fyr. Presset er stort for de 'gyldne par' som skal i sandhedsbåsen.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Three's a Crowd
programme.desc: Huset er i oprør, da Gio og Kaylens perfekte forhold begynder at slå revner. Asaf går i seng med den forkerte person.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Beer Goggles
programme.desc: Forholdet mellem Gio og Kaylen får alle op på dupperne, da Gio bager på Julia og alle andre piger i huset. Cam og Victoria har en nat, der ikke er værd at huske.

programme.title: MTV Teen Mom
programme.desc: Oplev de dramatiske øjeblikke, når de unge mødre tackler hverdagens udfordringer eller oplever uforglemmelige øjeblikke. Det er non-stop drama hele dagen, hver dag.

programme.title: Awkward: Happy Campers, Happier Trails
programme.desc: Jenna må vælge mellem et vigtigt SCU-event og lejrgenforeningen, noget der fører til et endnu større valg: Luke eller Matty. Men hun er ikke alene, for både Jake, Tamara og Lissa må også tage afgørende valg.

programme.title: Awkward: Pilot
programme.desc: Det går fra slemt til rigtig slemt for Jenna Hamilton, når et mystisk brev får alle til at tro, at hun har forsøgt at begå selvmord. Jenna foretager nogle store ændringer i sit liv snarere end at lade sin nye identitet definere hende.

programme.title: Awkward: Knocker Nightmare
programme.desc: Sadie og Lissa sms'er et nøgenfoto af Jenna i pigernes omklædningsrum til hele skolen. Ud over latterliggørelse og sladder får spøgen nogle overraskende reaktioner fra Jennas store forelskelse Matty.

programme.title: Awkward: The Way We Weren't
programme.desc: Jenna undrer sig over, om Matt vil stå frem med deres forhold, da han inviterer hende til en fest. Jenna indser også, at hun måske har mere til fælles med Jake.

programme.title: Awkward: The Scarlet Eye
programme.desc: Jenna vil definere sit forhold til Matty, men er bekymret for, at hun risikerer at miste ham. Imens nyder Tamara sin første sexskandale efter hun fik øjenbetændelse i en heftig omgang i et boblebad.

programme.title: Awkward: Jenna Lives
programme.desc: En mærkelig stalker puster liv i Jennas selvmordshistorie. Jenna undrer sig over, om hendes omdømme afholder Matty fra at se hende som kærestemateriale.

programme.title: Awkward: Queen Bee-atches
programme.desc: Jenna omgås de lede piger, da hun hjælper med Palos Verdes' elite mor/datter velgørende organisation. Det bliver mere akavet, da hun støder ind i Matty og Jake.

programme.title: Awkward: Over My Dead Body
programme.desc: Jenna får rollen som offer i en event om spirituskørsel. Hun kæmper med rollen, mens Jake og Matty kæmper om hendes opmærksomhed.

programme.title: Awkward: The Adventures of Aunt Ally and the Lil' Bitch
programme.desc: Da Laceys BFF Ally kommer til byen beslutter de at 'hjælpe' Jenna med at drikke sig stiv. Næste dag har en glemsom Jenna tømmermænd og kæmper med at huske den vilde aften og hvem hun kyssede.
programme.sub-title: The Adventures of Aunt Ally and the Lil' Bitch

programme.title: Awkward: My Super Bittersweet Sixteen
programme.desc: Jenna får en pinlig 16-års fødselsdag og må håndtere følgerne af alle dem, hun har skubbet væk. Efter hun dumper køreprøven, undrer hun sig over, om hun kan reparere forholdet til Matty og Tamara.

programme.title: Awkward: No Doubt
programme.desc: Matty inviterer Jenna ud på deres første rigtige date. Men en afsløring får Jenna til at tvivle på alt ved sin romance med Matty.

programme.title: Awkward: I Am Jenna Hamilton
programme.desc: Romantik er i luften, og alle er begejstrede for Winter Formal. Selvom Jenna længes efter den store spørger, forsøger hun ikke at lade Matty's afslappede holdning skuffe hende.

programme.title: Awkward: Fateful
programme.desc: Jenna må endelig bestemme sig mellem Jake og Matty. Tamaras kærlighedsliv tager en overraskende drejning. Ming bringer en uventet date, og mysteriet bag pleje-frontation-brevet afsløres.

programme.title: Awkward: Resolutions
programme.desc: Jenna undgår at beskæftige sig med afsløringen af, at hendes mor skrev konfrontationsbrevet. I stedet spreder hun julehumør og nytårsstemning, indtil Jakes gave tvinger hende til at beslutte, om hun er klar til at glemme Matty helt.

programme.title: Awkward: Sex, Lies and the Sanctuary
programme.desc: Jenna nyder, at forholdet med Jake endelig er blevet officielt, indtil hun hører om de seneste måneders skjulte kameraoptagelser fra Sanctuary. Hun går derefter ekstremt til værks - og hverver bl.a. Ming - for ødelægge båndet.

programme.title: Awkward: Three's a Crowd
programme.desc: Jenna prøver at slutte fred med Matty og behage Jake, men har svært ved at ignorere Mattys evindelige flirten og klæbrige opførsel. Hans handlinger får hende til at stille spørgsmålstegn ved, hvem der egentligt er problemet i trioen.

programme.title: Awkward: Are You There God? It's Me, Jenna
programme.desc: Jenna er stadig ikke kommet sig over sine forældres separation og føler sig ansvarlig. I et impulsivt forsøg på at tilgive sig selv søger hun tilflugt fra sine problemer hos de højere magter i den religiøse lejrskole.
programme.sub-title: Are You There God? It's Me, Jenna

programme.title: Awkward: My Love is a Black Heart
programme.desc: Jenna forbereder sig på sin første Valentinsdag med en kæreste, men både hun og Tamara bliver jaloux, da det går op for dem, at deres ekskærester måske er ved at være klar til at komme videre med deres liv og glemme dem.
programme.sub-title: My Love is a Black Heart

programme.title: Awkward: What Comes First: Sex or Love?
programme.desc: Jenna har stadig ikke genfundet sit fodfæste efter Jakes kærlighedserklæring, og hun overvejer, om det at have sex med ham vil give hende klarhed om sine egne følelser.
programme.sub-title: What Comes First: Sex or Love?

programme.title: Awkward: Another one Bites the Dust
programme.desc: Jenna er klar til at have sex med Jake efter endelig at have fået klarhed over sine følelser. Hendes beslutsomhed bliver imidlertid grundigt testet af tante Allys bryllup, en mand fra hendes mors fortid og en intrigant Sadie.

programme.title: Awkward: Time After Time
programme.desc: Dårlig timing og afsløringer efterlader både Jenna og Jake knuste.

programme.title: Awkward: Homewrecker Hamilton
programme.desc: Jenna har svært ved at rede trådene ud i sit forskruede kærlighedsliv efter brud og genforeninger med drengene - lige indtil en uventet tekst placerer hendes dramatiske liv lige midt i rampelyset.

programme.title: Awkward: Pick Me, Choose Me, Love Me
programme.desc: Efter Jennas udgivelse af sin blog har alle pludselig en mening om hendes liv. Mens alle andre følger med for underholdningens skyld, kræver Jake og Matty svar.
programme.sub-title: Pick Me, Choose Me, Love Me

programme.title: Awkward: Once Upon a Blog
programme.desc: Jennas fantasi løber af med hende, og hun omdanner sin blog til en fiktiv fortælling i et forsøg på at ændre sin skæbne. Ved at undersøge og forestille sig en anden udgave af sin fortid forsøger Jenna at gennemskue fremtiden.

programme.title: Awkward: The Other Shoe
programme.desc: Jennas beslutning om drengene når ud til alle. Læg dertil en tur til Europa, og alt ser ud til at gå godt for Jenna. Der sker imidlertid noget, der får Jenna til at betvivle, om det at få alt det, hun ønsker, er det, hun har brug for.

programme.title: Awkward: Cha-Cha-Cha-Changes
programme.desc: Tredje år på high school byder på overraskelser og forandringer, der kan ændre hele Jennas fremtid.

programme.title: Awkward: Responsibly Irresponsible
programme.desc: En klassekammerats død får Jenna til at tænke over tab og sorg, og hun tager ansvar for den hemmelighed, hun skjuler fra Matty.

programme.title: Awkward: A Little Less Conversation
programme.desc: Matty virker fjern, da han hører, at Jenna tror, hun er gravid, men Jenna vil næsten gøre alt for ikke at tage 'snakken'.

programme.title: Awkward: Let's Talk About Sex
programme.desc: Jennas far gør selv noget ved sagen og taler med Mattys forældre om deres børns forhold.

programme.title: Awkward: Indecent Exposure
programme.desc: Da Matty flytter ind hos Hamiltons indser Jenna, at hun har fået mere med i købet end hun havde håbet på.

programme.title: Awkward: That Girl Strikes Again
programme.desc: Spøgelserne fra Jennas fortid, og Jennas egen usikkerhed, melder sig på banen da det bliver Halloween i Palos Hills.

programme.title: Awkward: Guilt Trippin'
programme.desc: Jenna's første date til Homecoming-festen vækker skyldige minder om den pige, hun plejede at være og om de piger, der ikke har en date.

programme.title: Awkward: Rubbed Raw and Reeling
programme.desc: En udfordring fra Mr. Hart tvinger Jenna til at blotte sig selv se nogle svære afsløringer om sig selv i øjnene.

programme.title: Awkward: Reality Check
programme.desc: Efter at have taget en kop kaffe med Collin en sen aften kan Jenna ikke holde op med at tænke på ham og på, hvad det vil sige både at være småforelsket og at have en kæreste.

programme.title: Awkward: Redefining Jenna
programme.desc: Gnidningerne vokser mellem Jenna og Matty, da Collin inviterer hende til en smart fotografi-udstilling hjemme hos ham.

programme.title: Awkward: Surprise!
programme.desc: Efter at have været sammen med Collin beslutter Jenna sig for at holde op med at være utro før Matty finder ud af det.

programme.title: Awkward: And Then What Happened
programme.desc: Hvad skete der til surprisefesten - og er det virkelig helt slut mellem Jenna og Matty? Det ved kun de to, men deres venner forsøger at finde ud af sandheden.

programme.title: Awkward: Taking Sides
programme.desc: Jenna holder grillfest så hendes venner kan vænne sig til tanken om hendes og Collins spirende forhold. Men da deres støtte udebliver, tager hun drastiske midler i brug.

programme.title: Awkward: The Bad Seed
programme.desc: Efter at være blevet uvenner med Tamara og Ming, synes Jenna ikke at det spiller nogen rolle hvad hun gør længere - og det kaster hende ud i en vanskelig situation.

programme.title: Awkward: A Very Special Episode of Awkward
programme.desc: Val beder Mr Harts klasse om at skrive og fremføre et skuespil, og moralen i historien virker bekendt.
programme.sub-title: A Very Special Episode of Awkward

programme.title: Awkward: Less Than Hero
programme.desc: Efterdønningerne etter Jennas skænderi med vennerne får hende til at gå i byen. Men det som skulle blive en afslappende aften bliver en aften, hun skal reddes fra.

programme.title: Tully
programme.desc: 'Tully' er skrevet og instrueret af skaberne af den højtelskede Oscar-vinder 'Juno'. Skrevet af Diablo Cody (Young Adult) og instrueret af Jason Reitman (Thank You for Smoking, Up in the Air og Young Adult).

programme.title: The Killing of a Sacred Deer
programme.desc: Steven er dygtig hjertekirurg og gift med Anna, der er respekteret øjenlæge. De lever lykkeligt med deres to børn. Steven er ven med den 16-årige Martin, som er forældreløs. Tingene tager en mørk drejning, da Steven introducerer Martin for familien.

programme.title: Foxfire
programme.desc: Denne film handler om fire high school piger, der finder ud af, at de alle bliver lokket til at have seksuel omgang med deres biologilærer. Denne opdagelse fører dem til at blive allierede og venner. Kort tid efter, planlægger de hævn på deres lærer.

programme.title: Gallipoli
programme.desc: To unge mænd (Mel Gibson og Mark Lee) mødes i den australske hær i 1915. De krydser kontinenter og oceaner, bestiger pyramider og vandrer gennem Egyptens gamle sandklitter for at slutte sig til deres regiment i slaget ved Gallipoli.

programme.title: I'm Not There
programme.desc: I'm Not There' er en svimlende tur gennem Bob Dylans mytologiske verden og omskiftelige liv. Seks forskellige skuespillere spiller seks forskellige sider af Dylan i hans mest frugtbare årtier alt sammen set og hørt igennem Dylans udødelige tekster.

programme.title: Fisherman's Friends
programme.desc: FISHERMAN'S FRIENDS er baseret på den sande og utrolige historie om ti erfarne fiskere, som gik fra at optræde på den lokale pub i Port Isaac til udsolgte stadionkoncerter. Det er en hjertevarm, humoristisk og ikke mindst musikalsk film.

programme.title: Things We Lost In The Fire
programme.desc: En kvinde, der for nylig er blevet enke, inviterer sin mands betrængte, bedste ven til at bo hos sig og sine to børn. Da han gradvist får styr på sit liv, hjælper han familien med at acceptere og konfrontere deres tab.

programme.title: Da Ray Mødte Helen
programme.desc: En række bizarre, ikke forbundne begivenheder munder ud i, at både Ray og Helen ender med en større formue, som giver dem muligheden for at genopfinde sig selv. Alt i mens Ray og Helen fupper sig gennem et liv i sus og dus, krydses deres veje.

programme.title: Wonder Boys
programme.desc: En engelsk professor forsøger at håndtere sin kone, der forlader ham, ankomsten af hans redaktør, der har ventet på sin bog i syv år, og de forskellige problemer, som hans venner og medarbejdere involverer ham i.

programme.title: Hercules in New York
programme.desc: Hercules (Arnold Schwarzenegger) er forvist fra Mount Olympus og sendes til Jorden, hvor han finder ægte kærlighed og starter en lovende karriere i bodybuilder-branchen.

programme.title: Big Kill
programme.desc: Jim Andrews tager til byen Big Kill for at slutte sig til sin bror. Undervejs møder han to mænd eftersøgt af den mexicanske hær og hyrer dem til at vejlede og beskytte ham. Når de først er der, står de ansigt til ansigt med en truende prædikant.

programme.title: Defiance
programme.desc: Defiance er den utrolige men sande historie om tre brødre, som under 2. Verdenskrig sætter sig op mod den massive tyske besættelsesmagt.

programme.title: Gun
programme.desc: Detroit eksploderer i kriminalitet, og det er god business for Rich (50 Cent), der lever af at sælge ulovlige skydevåben. Men med politiet og FBI i hælene er det en farlig levevej, så Rich og hans partnere må konstant være på vagt.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Murdering Cowboy
programme.desc: The sun set on the Wild West long ago, but some people refused to notice. Claude Dallas was one of them. A wily trapper, Dallas typified the rugged individualism that forged this country. He went too far when he killed two game wardens in 1981.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The World Trade Center Bombing
programme.desc: Terrorist bombings are what happen in other countries. Not here in the United States. And yet, in 1993, it happened in New York City.

programme.title: The FBI Files: John Gotti: Convicted
programme.desc: John Gotti was ambitious, powerful and ruthless. He ruled with flash and conspicuous style, playing celebrity with the media and cat and mouse with the FBI. They called John Gotti the Teflon Don. Serious charges just wouldn't stick.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The True Story of Mississippi Burning
programme.desc: Philadelphia, Mississippi, 1964. A sleepy southern town steeped in tradition finds itself targeted for invasion.
programme.sub-title: The True Story of Mississippi Burning

programme.title: The FBI Files: A Model Killer
programme.desc: It's a model's job to rivet the public's attention. But in 1984, some aspiring models began attracting publicity in a terrible new way.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Hired Gun
programme.desc: When three people were found murdered in their home, it appeared like a burglary gone awry. But a crime this horrific deserved a closer look.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Cat and Mouse
programme.desc: He was a predator, abducting girls and young women from their own front yards in broad daylight. He was a sadist: phoning one victim's family, taunting them, boosting then dashing their hope, and he wouldn't stop until we stopped him.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Cracking The Cartel
programme.desc: A mother and child are kidnapped a bystander is murdered. Violence such as this shattered a quiet Texas neighborhood and exposed a drug cartel that flourished where it was least expected.

programme.title: The FBI Files: A Stranger in Town
programme.desc: She appeared on the highway in the spring, a young woman, her life cut short, her past and her identity a mystery. Only by finding out who she was could we ever hope to find her killer.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Hunter's Game
programme.desc: In the 1970s and 80s, people went to Alaska looking for a fresh start, to reinvent themselves, or to disappear for a while. Some of those disappearances weren't by choice.

programme.title: Angreb! Er det bedste forsvar
programme.desc: To snobbede millionærer fra Rio de Janeiro bliver udsat for pengeafpresning. Heldigvis møder de Elliott Vance (Terence Hill) og Greg Wonder (Bud Spencer), som ligner dem på en prik, og de hyrer dem for en tid som stand-ins.

programme.title: A Christmas Feast
programme.desc: Det er jul, og familien Oliverio gør sig klar til De Syv Fiskes Middag, en italiensk madtradition. Tony, en ung mand med store drømme og et endnu større hjerte, er med i forberedelserne og spekulerer på, om han mon vil finde kærligheden denne jul

programme.title: No Stranger Than Love
programme.desc: Hvad kan være mærkeligere end det hul, der opstår i Lucy Sherringtons stuegulv? Svaret viser sig at være kærlighed.

programme.title: Også engle spiser bønner
programme.desc: Charlie er fribryder i forbudstidens New York, og han nægter at være med til at fikse en kamp, og gangsterbossen Angelo har satset penge på modstanderen. Han bliver nødt til at flygte, og under flugten støder han på Sonny, der også er på flugt.

programme.title: How to Be
programme.desc: En skæv ungdomskomedie om Art (Robert Pattinson), som bliver forladt af kæresten og flytter tilbage til far og mor, hvorefter han får en 25-års krise.

programme.title: Tully
programme.desc: 'Tully' er skrevet og instrueret af skaberne af den højtelskede Oscar-vinder 'Juno'. Skrevet af Diablo Cody (Young Adult) og instrueret af Jason Reitman (Thank You for Smoking, Up in the Air og Young Adult).

programme.title: Who Gets The Dog
programme.desc: Da Olive og Clay mødte hinanden, var det kærlighed ved første blik. De blev gift, købte hus sammen og adopterede en hvalp – Wesley. Nu er det seks år senere, og de har besluttet at gå fra hinanden, men de vil begge beholde deres elskede Wesley.

programme.title: Scary Movie 2
programme.desc: Nogen er gået for vidt med din kærlighed til efterfølgere! Favoritfigurerne fra SCARY MOVIE er tilbage i en film, der skræmmer til mere uærbødig morskab end originalen med sin version af kliche-spøgelsesfilm.

programme.title: Youth In Revolt
programme.desc: På en ferie møder den kiksede teenager Nick Twisp drømmepigen Sheeni. Nick, der ikke tidligere har haft held med piger, vil gøre alt for at vinde hendes hjerte og opfinder et alter-ego, den flamboyante og dristige Francois Dillinger.

programme.title: About Hope
programme.desc: Thomas McKenzie har ledt efter den perfekte kvinde i hele sit liv. Da han møder to kvinder, som vækker hans interesse, går det op for ham, at den kærlighed, vi søger, ikke altid er den kærlighed, vi har brug for.

programme.title: On the Case: Shattered Hope
programme.desc: Nineteen-year-old Shelley Sikes vanishes one night after her shift, and then her abandoned, blood-streaked car is discovered on a dark roadway.

programme.title: Killer Soundtrack: Deadly Consequences
programme.desc: Award-winning music producer Phil Spector is responsible for some of the most successful albums in music history.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Without Mercy
programme.desc: Despite what you see in the movies, most bank robbers come in quietly, pass a note, and slip away. They want cash, not bloodshed. But in Richmond, Virginia, a pair of gunmen entered a bank with their guns blazing.

programme.title: Killer Soundtrack: City Under Siege
programme.desc: When a jury acquitted four Los Angeles police officers of using excessive force during Rodney King’s arrest, a mass protest against police brutality, injustice and racial discrimination ensued and quickly turned into a riot.

programme.title: On the Case: Justice Never Quits
programme.desc: Mary-Jane Marquardt, mother and wife from Chippewa, Wisconsin, was found stabbed to death in her own home. With Mary-Jane's son also missing, the detectives couldn't help but wonder if his disappearance was connected to the murder.

programme.title: Fraud Squad: Fraud Squad.S01E03.Charity Fraud & Investment Fraud
programme.desc: This story will show how scam artists take advantage of people's generosity to charities.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the 1970's South America faced a surge of political kidnappings and assassinations. When the killings spilled onto U.S. soil it was time for the FBI to step in.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Heist
programme.desc: In Arizona, an armored van loaded with cash failed to reach its destination. Authorities suspected an inside job. When the vehicle was recovered with the drivers and the cash missing, those suspicions grew even more.

programme.title: City Confidential
programme.desc: A scenic river town becomes the setting for a confrontation between the federal government and Rob Nuckols, owner of a militia-style compound on federal land.

programme.title: Forensic Files II
programme.desc: Detectives are determined to do whatever it takes to catch a criminally charged sex offender and murderer.

programme.title: On the Case: Pattern of Violence
programme.desc: A 22 year old real estate agent is discovered strangled to death inside a model home she was trying to sell.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Cold Cases
programme.desc: These cases took a decade or more to solve. There's no statute of limitations on murder. As a case turns cold, the clues become scarce, investigators must rely on science to close cold cases.

programme.title: On the Case: Eyes of a Killer
programme.desc: Eyewitnesses helplessly watch as a 19-year-old clerk is abducted from a Del Ray Beach convenience store.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Storm of Suspicion
programme.desc: The search for a missing mother of two during Hurricane Harvey.

programme.title: On the Case: A Deadly Betrayal
programme.desc: A beloved father of two is executed after a friendly poker game. Were the stakes too high? Or would police find the truth much closer to home?

programme.title: On the Case: Almost Home
programme.desc: A young woman's battered body is found on the side of the road. The shocking evidence from the crime leads police down a trail of tragedy.

programme.title: Notorious Criminals
programme.desc: Beginning in 1978, a string of university, airline and mail bombings terrorized the country, injured 23 people, and claimed three lives.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killer Instinct
programme.desc: In the early 1990's, a serial killer stalked lone victims in the dead of night, his hunting ground the suburbs of Washington, D.C., his target, anyone who owned a car.

programme.title: 48 Hours: The Shooting of Lauren Kanarek
programme.desc: 48 Hours is television's most popular true-crime series, investigating shocking cases and compelling real-life dramas with journalistic integrity and cutting-edge style.

programme.title: City Confidential
programme.desc: The murder of a vibrant 21-year-old leaves the peaceful community of Knoxville, Tennessee questioning its core values. But a family's persistence reminds Marble City what it's made of and residents band together to bring a killer down.

programme.title: South Park: Cartmanland
programme.desc: Cartman arver en million dollar efter sin bedstemor og opfylder sin livsdrøm om at eje sin egen forlystelsespark, Cartmanland!

programme.desc: Elskede entertainere dør i deres bedste levetid på grund af overdoser. Stan er ved at blive afsløret som kilden til de ulovlige stoffer.

programme.desc: Jon viser sine musikalske talenter, da han opfører en række sange om emner lige fra hans seksuelle kiksere til hans marihuana.

programme.title: Workaholics: Gone Catfishing
programme.desc: Adam og Ders planlægger en 4/20-fest, men Blakes nye kæreste rakker ned på dem.

programme.sub-title: Du er ved at blive gammel

programme.desc: Cartman og Butters får fat i en drone og tager på en flyvetur rundt i kvarteret.

programme.desc: Randy kommer med en sarkastisk bemærkning om, at det er for farligt for børn at spille football. Det er startskuddet til en national sport der involverer bh'er og en ballon.

programme.desc: Kyle vil bare spille tv-spil med sin lillebror. Men når Ike ikke vil spille med ham mere, er Kyle bange for, at den næste generation forbigår ham.

programme.desc: Et ubestrideligt bånd knyttes mellem en hvid mand og en indianer.

programme.desc: Cartman drømmer, at han har et nærgående møde med et rumvæsen. De andre drenge er overbeviste om, at drømmen var virkelig, og at han har været offer for en anal sondeundersøgelse af et rumvæsen.

programme.title: South Park: Butterballs
programme.desc: Butters bliver mobbet af sin bedstemor, og Stan vil skabe opmærksomhed om problemet ved at indspille en video, men dens succes stiger ham snart til hovedet.

programme.desc: Drengene efterligner Timmy, som har ADHD, for st slippe for lektierne.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Serpent's Pass

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Drill
programme.desc: Aang discovers a secret Fire Nation super weapon heading straight for Ba Sing Se and must stop it before it destroys the great wall that protects the city from invasion.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: City of Walls and Secrets
programme.desc: Aang and the kids finally arrive in Ba Sing Se to see the Earth King, only to find mysterious forces within the city conspiring to stop them. Meanwhile, Jet tries to find proof that Zuko and Uncle are Fire Nation.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Tales of Ba Sing Se
programme.desc: A series of short stories, highlighting different characters and their individual adventures in the city. Tales of Katara and Toph, Uncle, Sokka, Aang, Zuko, and Momo.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Appa's Lost Days
programme.desc: In this special episode, we go back in time to the moment Appa was stolen, and find out exactly what happened to him, and where's he's been all this time - and where he is now!

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Lake Laogai
programme.desc: While searching for Appa, the kids run into Jet, but are torn about whether to trust him or not. Meanwhile, Zuko also hunts for Appa.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Earth King
programme.desc: The kids battle Long Feng the Dai Li when they attempt to show the Earth King the vast conspiracy taking place in his city. Zuko becomes seriously ill and has feverish dreams as he faces a spiritual crisis.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Guru
programme.desc: Aang starts to learn control of the Avatar State from Guru Pathik at the Eastern Air Temple. Sokka is reunited with his father.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Crossroads of Destiny
programme.desc: When Aang has a vision that Katara is in danger, Aang, Sokka, and Toph all rush back to Ba Sing Se to save her. They meet up with Iroh, who asks their help in saving Zuko who had been captured as well.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Awakening
programme.desc: After sustaining serious injuries at the end of season two, Aang awakens to find himself aboard a Fire Nation ship. Meanwhile, Zuko journeys home.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Headband
programme.desc: Mistaken for a Fire Nation School student, the disguised Aang is forced to enroll in a Fire nation school. Aang's hair helped to disguise him better with his head band.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Painted Lady
programme.desc: When the gang comes to a suffering fishing village, a mysterious spirit appears to help the villagers.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Sokka's Master
programme.desc: When Sokka feels he's not contributing enough to the group, he seeks out a mysterious master to teach him the ways of the sword.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Beach
programme.desc: Zuko, Azula, Mai, and Ty Lee go on vacation to Lo and Li's beach house, where they learn much about themselves and each other.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Avatar and The Firelord
programme.desc: Aang and Zuko are taken on parallel adventures that give them insight into their forefathers' pasts - but how does the tale of Roku and Sozin matter to them now?

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Runaway
programme.desc: When Toph discovers a quick way to make cash, Katara disapproves, and the rift between them has disastrous consequences.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Puppetmaster
programme.desc: In a Halloween installment, the gang looks into strange disappearances in a spooky town. There, an old lady named Hama teaches Katara some secret Waterbending techniques.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Nightmares and Daydreams
programme.desc: On the eve of the eclipse, Aang's anxiety gets the better of him. His dreams become nightmares, and soon he can no longer tell dream from reality.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Day of Black Sun Part 1: The Invasion
programme.desc: It is the Day of Black Sun and the group meets up with the invasion force."The day has finally arrived and Aang is ready to take on the Fire Lord.
programme.sub-title: The Day of Black Sun Part 1: The Invasion

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Day of Black Sun Part 2: The Eclipse
programme.desc: The eclipse has started and the gang only has a few minutes to get into an underground bunker and find and defeat Ozai.
programme.sub-title: The Day of Black Sun Part 2: The Eclipse

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Western Air Temple
programme.desc: The gang leaves the Fire Nation, humbled and embarrassed by the failure of the invasion. They head to the Western Air Temple.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Firebending Masters
programme.desc: Aang is ready to start his firebending training. However, as Zuko attempts to teach him, he realizes he has lost all his firebending power.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Boiling Rock Part 1
programme.desc: Sokka and Zuko break into The Boiling Rock Prison, the Fire Nation's highest security prison, to rescue Hakoda. When they develope an escape plan after finding Hakoda not there, other prisoners get involved and ruin it.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Boiling Rock Part 2
programme.desc: This episode is continuing the jailbreak from the previous episode. Sokka, Hakoda, Zuko and Suki form a new escape plan, but it is complicated by the arrival of Princess Azula.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Southern Raiders
programme.desc: Katara and Zuko journey together to find the man responsible for the death of Katara's mother, Kya, who was killed in a Southern Water Tribe raid.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Ember Island Players
programme.desc: The gang goes to the theater to see a play about themselves, but are not happy with the production and the inaccurate portrayals of themselves.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Sozin's Comet Part 1: The Phoenix King
programme.desc: Aang finds out that Ozai plans to burn down the Earth Kingdom with an airship fleet. He disappears during the night, having sleepwalked onto a mysterious moving island.
programme.sub-title: Sozin's Comet Part 1: The Phoenix King

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Sozin's Comet Part 2: The Old Masters
programme.desc: The gang find Iroh with June's help. Iroh suggests that Zuko challenge Azula for the position of Fire Lord, with Katara to help. The others decide to intercept the airship fleet.
programme.sub-title: Sozin's Comet Part 2: The Old Masters

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Sozin's Comet Part 3: Into the Inferno
programme.desc: Sokka, Toph and Suki begin destroying the airship fleet. Aang duels Ozai, but is soon overwhelmed because of his reluctance to kill him.
programme.sub-title: Sozin's Comet Part 3: Into the Inferno

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Sozin's Comet Part 4: Avatar Aang
programme.desc: Katara eventually defeats Azula by trapping her in ice, and heals Zuko. Sokka, Toph and Suki destroy the airship fleet.
